Report Description///POTENTIAL RELEASE/// INCIDENT TYPE: MASS SAR LOCATION: GRAVINA POINT, KETCHIKAN, ALASKA TIME INCIDENT OCCURRED: 0845 AKDT / 1645 Z TIME OF INITIAL REPORT TO NCC: 1310 EDT / 1710 Z NAME OF REPORTING UNIT: USCG SECTOR SOUTHEAST ALASKA AMPLIFYING INFORMATION: • ON JULY 16, USCG SECTOR SOUTHEAST ALASKA INITIATED A CRITICAL INCIDENT COMMUNICATIONS (CIC) CONFERENCE CALL TO DISCUSS A MAYDAY HEARD ON VHF CHANNEL 16 FOR A VESSEL TAKING ON WATER. • THE MOTOR VESSEL (M/V) EAGLE ONE EXPRESS, A WHALE WATCHING VESSEL WITH 36 PEOPLE ONBOARD (30 ADULTS AND 06 CHILDREN), BEACHED ITSELF NEAR GRAVINA POINT, ALASKA. • USCG SECTOR SOUTHEAST ALASKA ISSUED AN URGENT MARINE INFORMATION BROADCAST (UMIB) AND LAUNCHED A HELICOPTER FROM USCG AIR STATION SITKA. • USCG SECTOR SOUTHEAST ALASKA ALSO LAUNCHED A 45-FOOT RESPONSE BOAT FROM USCG STATION KETCHIKAN, WHICH IS CURRENTLY ON SCENE. • FOUR GOOD SAMARITAN VESSELS ALSO RESPONDED AND PEOPLE FROM THE M/V EAGLE ONE EXPRESS WERE OFFLOADED TO THE VARIOUS GOOD SAMARITAN VESSELS. • FULL ACCOUNTABILITY AND MEDICAL SCREENINGS ARE STILL BEING CONDUCTED. • USCG NCC STOOD DOWN THE CIC PROCESS WITH THE CONCURRENCE OF BOTH AREA COMMANDS. • USCG NCC WILL RELEASE AN EMAIL UPDATE WHEN FULL ACCOUNTABILITY HAS BEEN ACHIEVED
